latest_events.title: Mali: Dozo hunters and jihadists clash for a village near Djenné
latest_events.summary: In Mali, the village of Sounga, which belongs to the commune of Mougna, near Djenné in the Mopti region, continues to resist the jihadists of Jnim, linked to al-Qaeda. While the surrounding villages have bowed to the domination of the jihadists, Sounga refuses to submit, provoking violent clashes last week between the Jnim jihadists and the traditional Dozo hunters, who strive to protect the population in this part of the territory where the Malian army is not present.

The Chadian government on Tuesday rejected accusations by the Nigerien authorities that a drone strike carried out from Chadian territory targeted an area of the Agadez region on the night of 24 October, causing the death of two civilians and injuring several others, according to the toll announced by Niamey In a statement read on national television, the Minister of Communication and government spokesman, Gassim Chérif Mahamat, assured that Chad had "in no way ordered, conducted or supported" an air military operation against Niger.

latest_events.title: Mali: 54 dead bodies discovered in a camp, EIGs implicated
latest_events.summary: A massacre of civilian populations was reported in the region of Menaka, Mali. Fifty-four dead bodies were discovered in a camp located about 35 kilometers southeast of the city. The Islamic State in the Greater Sahara (EIGs) is implicated in these killings, according to the first testimonies collected by the Malian army In a statement seen by Seneweb, the General Staff of the Armed Forces indicates that a joint patrol of the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) and their partners was deployed on the ground after reports of a terrorist attack against civilian populations in the operational sub-sector of Menaka.

latest_events.summary: (Nairobi) – Mali’s armed forces and the allied Russia-controlled Africa Corps have committed new atrocities against civilians in central Mali during renewed fighting, Human Rights Watch said today. On September 16, 2026, an apparent military drone strike in Guélédié village, Mopti region, killed eight civilians and injured at least six others. Between May and August, Malian and Africa Corps forces held numerous detainees inhumanely in a metal container at an army base in Sévaré town, Mopti region, where many were tortured, including with severe beatings, electric shock, and waterboarding.

latest_events.title: Two European women kidnapped in Niger freed in Libya
latest_events.summary: An Austrian and a Swiss women kidnapped in Niger more than a year and a half ago have been freed and are in Libya, Bern and Vienna announced Thursday. Sixty-nine-year-old Swiss national Claudia Abbt and 76-year-old Eva Gretzmacher arrived in the eastern city of Benghazi where they received medical treatment. Their release follows an intervention by Libyan military commander Khalifa Haftar, who controls the east and parts of the south of the country.
